notes.content:

• Enabled [b]destruction[/b] for all buildings

• Moved [b]squares[/b] from the Decorations section to Utilities

• Improved [b]script optimization[/b] – better performance with more buildings on the map

• Beta version tested with help from [b]SNAFU[/b] and [b]thedoctor[/b] – big thanks to both of you!

[h2]⚠️ Known Issues[/h2]
• Ongoing issues with the [b]Save & Load system[/b] – we’re fully rewriting it from scratch (still in progress)  
• [b]Church[/b] has been temporarily removed from the available buildings – needs further testing  
• [b]House variations[/b] also temporarily removed – require additional work

notes.title: Colonize 0.2 is live - Now with cows and sheeps!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Colonizers; we are pushing a Major update, many fixes, and some new buildings and decorations! Thanks to our community and kudos to our community beta testers -[b] the doctor, Lisek, Rezler, Umar, FastDepp, S.N.A.F.U.[/b]

[list]
[h2]Added cows![/h2]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FK5S1Z3n/cowshed.png[/img]
[h2]Added sheep![/h2]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3Jk0B6Zc/sheepfold.png[/img]
[h2]Added squares, small and tall flags[/h2]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/dQHTGvGC/square.png[/img]
[h2]Added gates for the fences![/h2]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/kG46LhPD/fences.png[/img]
[h2]We have added the palisade and palisade gate. [/h2]
Now, it is always open, but it will be changed so that a player can choose an open or closed state.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/KjPGqPR4/palisades.png[/img]
[h2]Added + and - to each building[/h2]
You can choose the maximum amount for storage in the buildings - for example, you can turn off the firewood creation for one sawmill and open it for another.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fL5S2QF6/plusminus.png[/img]

Other fixes & improvements:

[*] Changed UI scale in the game - now it should not scale uniformly
[*] Added brightness and contrast
[*] The language settings are saved only after confirmation
[*] Trees are saved even while they are being chopped down and will reappear in the exact location
[*] The amount of wood obtained from a tree depends on the tree's height
[*] If one resource output is full, the production will switch to the second output until it is also full
[*] The woodcutter's tree-finding algorithm has been improved to prioritize the nearest trees
[*] After saving and loading, people's positions on benches are retained. The same applies to the Hunter, who previously behaved strangely
[*] The bakery now correctly shows when it is in operation
[*] We completely reworked the save system, which should fix most of the problems
[*] Eating House has more storage for meat, fish, potatoes
[*] Change default time for warehouse, eating house, cellar, and woodcutter
[*] General optimization improved, turning off some cast shadows for small objects and rocks
[*] Fixed - #1986 - After manually switching innkeeper, he tends to get stuck there
[*] Fixed - #1985 - Clicking on the bottom of the screen will move you to the map too
[*] Fixed - #1894 - Children grown-up has the same clothes
[*] Fixed - #1941 - Saving takes a too-long time
[*] Fixed - #1952 - Wrong sitting point on one bench
[*] Fixed - #1987 - Inn doors are opening in opposite directions
[*] Fixed - #2005 - Bakery Light on off 
[*] Fixed - #2011 - Change the sound of the children's audio
[*] Fixed - #2018 - Residents often forget to eat despite being in the Eating House building
[/list]

notes.title: Colonize 0.1.7.5 - Added Polish & Chinese Languages!
notes.content:
[b]New Features and Improvements:
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Childbirth:[/b] Families will have a more balanced mix of boys and girls.
[*] [b]Adjusted Eating:[/b] Citizens prioritize eating based on their hunger levels. For instance, they will consume eggs before meat when they are less hungry.
[*] [b]New Statistics Window:[/b] Access detailed population statistics with the newly added window.
[*] [b]Added Languages:[/b] Polish and Simplified Chinese languages are now available.
[*] [b]Improved Route Searching (Navmesh): [/b]Route searching and road updates are now up to 200% faster in some cases.
[*] [b]Population Window Hide:[/b] When clicking on a humanoid, the population window will automatically hide.
[*] [b]Bakery, Public Shelter, and Cellar Lights and Window Adjustments:[/b] Lighting and window adjustments have been made to enhance visual clarity.
[*] [b]Rock Small Collider[/b]: Small colliders have been removed from small rocks to facilitate smoother road creation.
[*] [b]Smoke Adjustment:[/b] Smoke effects have been fine-tuned for improved visual aesthetics.
[*] [b]RIP Meshes without Grass:[/b] Rest in Peace (RIP) Meshes no longer feature grass for better consistency.
[/list]

This update enhances lighting, collision detection, visual effects, and language options, providing an enriched gameplay experience. Additionally, RIP meshes have been updated for better consistency and immersion.

notes.title: Colonize 0.1.7.0
notes.content:
[b]Colonize Version 0.1.7: Explore the Latest Updates![/b]

Colonizers,

We're thrilled to announce the release of Colonize version 0.1.7, bringing many exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Let's dive in:

[b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Fences:[/b] Four new types of wooden fences enhance your colony's aesthetics and structure, providing new landscaping possibilities.
[*] [b]Revamped Building Menu Icons:[/b] The building menu now has a fresh look and all-new icons, making navigation and selection easier than ever.
[*] [b]Audio for Door Opening: [/b]Immerse yourself further into the world of Colonize with added audio effects when doors are opened, enhancing gameplay immersion.
[*] [b]Redesigned Building Menu:[/b] When placing buildings, enjoy a redesigned menu interface that provides a more intuitive and user-friendly experience.
[*] [b]Illustrated Load Sockets:[/b] Visualize your colony's functionality with added visual illustrations to load sockets, improving clarity and aesthetics.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Corrected camera positioning for a better view at the start of the game.
[*] Adjusted citizen attributes for smoother interactions and gameplay mechanics.
[*] Implemented minor bug fixes to enhance game stability and performance.
[/list]


Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we strive to make Colonize the best it can be. Happy colonizing!

notes.title: Colonize 0.1.6
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow Colonizers! We're thrilled to present to you our latest substantial update!

[list]
[*] [b]Livestock Sustainability:[/b] Pigs and Chickens now have increased longevity without food.
[*] [b]Work Experience:[/b] All professions now utilize experience gained at work.
[*] [b]Enhanced Visuals:[/b] Added vibrant Citizen illustrations.
[*] [b]Improved Interface:[/b] Citizens now feature three tabs for better organization.
[*] [b]Access to Colonize Wiki:[/b] Explore the inaugural version of the Colonize wiki via the Menu.
[*] [b]Refined Audio Mixing:[/b] Experience superior audio quality with enhanced mix levels.
[*] [b]Snowscape Optimization:[/b] Resolved a bug affecting trees in snowy areas.
[*] [b]Introduction of Firewood:[/b] Essential addition for heating and cooking purposes.
[*] [b]Lush Grasslands:[/b] Grass now appears denser with tile-based rendering across all maps.
[*] [b]Loading Screen:[/b] Enjoy a loading screen while the game initializes.
[*] [b]Streamlined Features:[/b] Winter Clothes removed for a smoother gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Cellar Functionality:[/b] The cellar no longer collects water from the Well.
[*] [b]Performance Enhancements:[/b] Enjoy a 10-15fps improvement for smoother gameplay.
[*] [b]Auditory Feedback:[/b] Added clicking sounds to all buttons for better user experience.
[*] [b]UI Polishing:[/b] Corrected padding issues in the settings menu.
[*] [b]Ship Renaming:[/b] Harbor name changed to Trade Ship for accuracy.
[*] [b]Seasonal Wardrobe:[/b] Clothes now automatically switch to winter attire.
[*] [b]Road Connectivity:[/b] Roads now snap into place after loading.
[*] [b]Inn Consumption:[/b] Increased food consumption rate in the Inn.
[*] [b]Storage Adjustments:[/b] Cellar storage limits revised for certain resources.
[*] [b]Birth Rate Control:[/b] Added a slider for controlling house population growth.
[*] [b]Expanded Audio Library:[/b] Additional sound effects for various buildings.
[*] [b]Annual Immigration:[/b] Expect new arrivals every January if shelter space is available.
[*] [b]Bakery Automation:[/b] The bakery now autonomously receives water.
[*] [b]Informative Notifications:[/b] Receive alerts for restricted building areas or insufficient food for livestock.
[*] [b]Tutorial Enhancement:[/b] Bug fixed regarding tab selection in the tutorial.
[*] [b]Walking Speed Correction:[/b] Resolved issue with walking speed at maximum velocity.
[*] [b]Improved Stability:[/b] Enjoy smoother FPS performance with over 200 citizens.
[*] [b]Seasonal Farming:[/b] Farmers refrain from planting seeds when temperatures drop below 8 degrees Celsius.
[/list]

In addition, numerous minor updates and tweaks have been implemented for an even more immersive experience!
